info.name: Savvy Video API
info.description: Import this collection. Set base_url and api_token from the Colab tunnel cell. Direct media uploads use form-data: config is Text; matching named uploads are File. The job ID is captured automatically. Read GET /options for descriptions and defaults. Save the download response as MP4.

formdata.description: JSON Text. Example overrides defaults for a faster first 960x540 preview; omit settings to use documented defaults.

request.description: Paste the larger LLM JSON into config.storyboard. Gemma writes slide copy and headers. In Body → form-data, select a file in each File row you use. If skipping an upload, uncheck its File row and remove the matching reference from config. The company logo and closing artwork have bundled defaults. Match the scene number in scene_media to your storyboard. Let Postman set Content-Type.

formdata.description: Paste the narration plan under storyboard. Keep each file_field equal to its matching File row.
Select your actual background video file.
Select an image, GIF, or video for scene 2. Update both the JSON scene assignment and the row key when you change the file field name.
Select static JPG, PNG, or WebP artwork. Timing and narration come from storyboard.closing.

request.description: Wait for completed status, then send and save this response as an .mp4 file. Authentication is inherited from the collection.
